findings.message: The OnboardingService._emit method uses push_warning when event_bus is null (line 84-85). This is fine for development, but in production this could spam warnings if called frequently. Consider using a flag to limit warning frequency or using a more appropriate logging level.
The STEP_PLAY constant is named 'test_play' (line 11) which might be confusing. Consider renaming to 'play' or 'first_play' to match the acceptance criteria terminology of 'first playable quest'.

UsabilityTelemetryTracker emit order: start_session -> mark_first_fun -> mark_loop_complete -> end_session. This flow correctly captures the time-to-first-fun metric which is a key KPI for child onboarding confidence.
The onboarding overlay in create_shell.gd correctly maps all step IDs to localized Polish strings (lines 1362-1366). This ensures child-friendly language throughout the FTUE.

acceptance_criteria.child_quick_start: PASS - OnboardingService implements 4-step flow (welcome, place_first, paint_first, play/test_play) that guides child through first playable loop. STEP_PLACE_FIRST advances on 'place' or 'add_node' action, STEP_PAINT_FIRST on 'paint', STEP_PLAY on 'play' or 'run_test'.
acceptance_criteria.confidence_feedback_instrumented: PASS - UsabilityTelemetryTracker tracks time_to_first_fun_seconds (line 104), adult_rescue_count (line 105), frustration stats (line 106). mark_first_fun() captures the key 'first fun' metric (line 42-53). mark_loop_complete() tracks loop completion time (line 55-67).

checklist.hexagonal_boundaries: PASS - OnboardingService extends RefCounted (not Node). Only depends on DomainEventBus, PlayerProfile, and domain events. UsabilityTelemetryTracker depends only on TelemetryPort and ClockPort. No Godot engine imports in application layer.
checklist.kid_safety_and_parental_controls: PASS - Onboarding flow is optional (can be skipped if already complete via line 27-28). Preferences are stored per-profile (line 37, 76). No forced data collection or external network calls.
checklist.localization: PASS - All onboarding strings are localized in Polish (create_shell.gd lines 1362-1366). Uses _t() helper which falls back to key if localization not available.
checklist.event_driven: PASS - Service uses DomainEventBus for all notifications (OnboardingStepChangedEvent, OnboardingStepCompletedEvent, OnboardingFinishedEvent). No direct Godot signals (Phase 7c requirement met).

compatibility_verification.create_shell_integration: COMPATIBLE - create_shell.gd wires OnboardingService to UI via event_bus subscriptions (lines 458-460) and overlay connections (lines 461-464). Service is instantiated at line 454.
compatibility_verification.telemetry_integration: COMPATIBLE - UsabilityKPIReportingService aggregates first_fun data (lines 38, 52-54) and reports median time_to_first_fun (line 87). This provides parent dashboard visibility into child onboarding success.
compatibility_verification.session_lifecycle: COMPATIBLE - Telemetry tracker integrates with session lifecycle: start_session at session start, end_session at teardown, with all intermediate events tracked.

summary: TASK-034 implementation provides a complete kid onboarding confidence loop with 4-step guided flow and comprehensive instrumentation. The OnboardingService correctly tracks progress and emits domain events, while UsabilityTelemetryTracker captures all required metrics (time-to-first-fun, loop completion, frustration signals). Two low-severity findings suggest minor improvements to warning frequency and constant naming. Overall: APPROVE. The implementation fully meets acceptance criteria and provides valuable telemetry for understanding child onboarding success.
